title: A rename carries over to canned jobs that hold the part
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COCJ-01) is stocked at {Location-A} with 5 on hand.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15441) has a line, {Line-1} (for example "Replace - Brake pot"), holding {Part-A} picked from stock.
  • Canned job {Canned-job-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL COCJ Job), saved from {Line-1}, holds {Part-A}.
  • The new number, {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COCJNEW-02), is unused and does not contain {Part-A}.
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A}, go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Replace the Part Number with {Number-A}.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Parts tab.
  6. Click New Line.
  7. Type {Canned-job-A} in Title.
  8. Pick {Canned-job-A} in the list.
  9. Click Save & Close.
  10. Read the part row on the new line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the rename is saved and the window closes.
  • Step 5: the part already picked onto {Work-order-1}, a completed record, still reads {Part-A}.
  • Step 9: the canned job is added and finds the renamed part: no part is left out and no warning appears.
  • Step 10: the part on the new line reads {Number-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R19, §4 Key Decisions, Story 13 context note, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 6.4 (A canned job that holds it), 13 Oct copy. Tech plan §6 Phase 6 open-work table. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R19: “A rename carries over to open work that holds this part, at every location: purchase order lines not yet fully received, part requests not yet received or returned, canned jobs, and returns that are not completed take the new number. A delivery that is not yet accepted is covered by its open purchase order lines. Receiving, ordering, applying a canned job and returning then find the renamed part.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (rename carry-over): “A rename carries over to work that is still open. Open purchase order lines, open part requests, canned jobs and open returns follow the new number, so receiving and returning still find the part. Records already completed keep the number they were written with.”
  • PRD Story 13 context note (completed records): “Records already completed, such as received purchase order lines, completed returns and past work orders and invoices, keep the number they were written with.”
  • Tech plan, 7 Oct 2026, §6 Phase 6, open-work definition for the rename carry-over: “Rows are linked by id only, never by number.”
